title: 出口越强：刺激越不急，美银首席点破政策底气
speaker: Helen Qiao

segments.en: X forces indeed, as you said, David, a double edge sword.
segments.zh: 确实，正如大卫所说，X因素是一把双刃剑。

segments.en: So you need it. It's a blessing, because you need it at the time.
segments.zh: 所以你需要它。这是好事，因为当时你需要。

segments.en: One, domestic demand is still relatively weak.
segments.zh: 第一，内需仍然相对疲软。

segments.en: You better have it. Otherwise, growth will be lower. But at the same time, because exports running at 20, 30% plus levels,
segments.zh: 最好拥有它。否则增长会更低。但与此同时，由于出口以20%、30%以上的速度增长，

segments.en: it is really hard for policy makers to completely pivot and say, you know what, we need to do whatever it takes
segments.zh: 政策制定者确实很难完全转向说，你知道吗，我们需要不惜一切代价

segments.en: to stimulate the economy. Compared to, for example, summer 2024, at that point, economic growth was also weak.
segments.zh: 来刺激经济。相比之下，例如2024年夏天，当时经济增长也很疲软。

segments.en: Domestic demand was bleak, but at the same time, exports was nowhere near here, right?
segments.zh: 内需低迷，但与此同时，出口远不及现在，对吧？

segments.en: Export growth was low single digit, and therefore, that was much easier for the September stimulus to come by.
segments.zh: 出口增长为低个位数，因此，9月份的刺激措施要容易得多。

segments.en: But this time, I think it is much more difficult. At the time, one, exports still running red hot.
segments.zh: 但这一次，我认为要困难得多。当时，第一，出口仍然火热。

segments.en: There's concerns over the sustainability of the AI build out.
segments.zh: 有人担心AI建设的可持续性。

segments.en: Does that lead to more momentum to start fading when it comes to exports then?
segments.zh: 这是否会导致出口势头开始减弱？

segments.en: For China, I mean, how do you see, you know, it doesn't seem with the domestic economy or demand can make up for any sort of momentum that could be lost potentially overseas now.
segments.zh: 对中国而言，你怎么看？目前国内经济或需求似乎无法弥补海外可能失去的势头。

segments.en: I think going into 2027, that's indeed,
segments.zh: 我认为进入2027年，确实如此，
